context: Gale had died and left a carefully prepared, theatrical protocol that could turn a blank letter into a Scroll of True Resurrection; the player followed that protocol and brought him back to life. Although the cueing voice the player first encountered was a pre‑recorded, showy manifestation of Gale, this scene is the real man returned—relieved, grateful, and a little breathless. He acknowledges the player's right to demand explanations but warns he has precious few answers and some secrets cannot yet be revealed, offering to answer only a single question. The exchanges reflect both his theatrical, erudite manner and a genuine reluctance to disclose certain matters despite his gratitude.
